newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen testing psychological 800 level.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen testing psychological 800 level.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to test psychological 800 level on Monday but brokers said the market would consolidate afterwards.
"Many investors seemed to be in euphoria. The market is overheated," said Choi Dong-chul of Ssangyong Securities. "Seoul stocks are on the tail of a liquidity-driven market," he added.
The composite stock index closed Saturday's session 2.82 points higher at 791.97. Trading volume totalled 59.7 million, the largest ever for the half-day session.
